samples.evidence: Although male suicide has received research attention, the gendered experiences of men bereaved by male suicide are poorly understood. Addressing this knowledge gap, we share findings drawn from a photovoice study of Canadian-based men who had lost a male friend, partner, or family member to suicide. The text refers to "The current study" as a singular entity without distinguishing multiple sub-studies. Table 1. Aggregated Sample Demographics (N = 20). A total of 20 men ranging in age from 20 to 63 years old (M = 39 years) who had lost a male to suicide participated in the study.
